title: Claim (3) of Lemma 5.4: the bound c₁/dist(x, La) for every ψ₀ satisfying (S1) and (S2), by induction over face dimension
statement: Let m, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≥ 1 and d := m + 1 + ℓ. There is c₁ = c₁(m, ℓ) ≥ 0 such that for every a ∈ ℝ^d with 1/4 < a_i < 3/4 for all i, with La := {y ∈ ℝ^d : there is a set J of indices with |J| = m + 2 and y_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ J} and C := [0,1]^d, and for every map ψ₀ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d satisfying (S1): for every x ∈ C ∖ La for which there is a set I of exactly ℓ indices with x_i ∈ {0,1} for all i ∈ I, ψ₀(x) = x; and (S2): for every set J of indices with |J| ≥ m + 2, every c ∈ ℝ^d with c_i = a_i for i ∈ J and c_i ∈ {0,1} for i ∉ J, every x ∈ C ∖ La with x_i = c_i for i ∉ J, every y ∈ C and s > 0 with y_i − c_i = s·(x_i − c_i) for all i, and such that y_i ∈ {0,1} for some i ∈ J: ψ₀(y) = ψ₀(x); the following holds: (γ) for every x ∈ C ∖ La and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with |ψ₀(x′) − ψ₀(x)| ≤ (c₁/dist(x, La) + ε)·|x′ − x| for all x′ ∈ C ∖ La with |x′ − x| < δ (Euclidean norm; dist(x, La) = infDist x La).
lean_statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∀ ψ₀ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, x i = 0 ∨ x i = 1) → ψ₀ x = x) → (∀ (J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ))) (c x y : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (s : ℝ), m + 2 ≤ J.card → (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → (∀ i ∉ J, c i = 0 ∨ c i = 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i ∉ J, x i = c i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → 0 < s → (∀ i, y i - c i = s * (x i - c i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, y i = 0 ∨ y i = 1) → ψ₀ y = ψ₀ x) → ∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ₀ x') (ψ₀ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x
